Definition: from G191; hearing (the act, the sense or the thing heard):--audience, ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor.
BiblicalUsage: The word is hearing itself — the act, the sense, and the report. His fame went out through all Syria; Isaiah's prophecy is fulfilled in those who hear and never understand; Paul says faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God; and Hebrews says the readers have become dull of hearing. The same word covers the fame of Jesus, the deafness of Israel, and the birth of faith.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Romans 10:17 is the hinge of the whole word: faith comes by hearing. The gospel is a message before it is anything else, and it enters through the ear — which is why dull hearing is so dangerous, and why preaching matters so much.
